item.title: Parents left scrambling after South Tampa preschool announces closure
item.description: Parents in South Tampa are scrambling to find childcare after learning their children's preschool is closing at the end of the school year.Good Shepherd Day School announced it's closing on May 29. The school is a ministry of Good Shepherd Lutheran Church.Parents received a letter earlier this week announcing the closure of the preschool, which serves dozens of families. item.description: Tampa Bay’s report card is in, and the region’s workforce pipeline remains strong. item.title: Florida bill could allow armed volunteers at houses of worship
item.description: A bill that unanimously passed through the Florida Senate last week could change how churches, temples and mosques handle security.This proposal comes as concerns grow about gun violence at places of worship across the country.If approved by the House, Senate Bill 52 would allow churches to use armed volunteers instead of hiring licensed security guards.
